title: schc_session_table.h: pin reterminal semantics + terminal_time units in contract
description: j8z0 security-pass findings (pre-existing header gaps, same file/class): (1) lichen_schc_tombstone_put does not document duplicate-key reterminal behavior - the code (schc_session_table.c:149-165) does a monotonic refresh (high_water/terminal_time advance-only, outcome overwritten), which is replay-protection-critical per spec 5.6, but a caller reading the header cannot distinguish that from a wholesale replace that would let a replayed terminal frame regress high-water; sibling contracts (ctx_alloc, floor_put) document their duplicate-key semantics. (2) terminal_time units/epoch unspecified in the public contract - eviction ordering and the hold-down arithmetic (schc_session_control.c:303 now_s - terminal_time) assume a monotonic seconds base shared by all entries. Pin both in the header doc comments.
